_doc: The few fixed facts every townsperson knows about WHERE it is. Added 2026-11-15, after two NPCs in Britain said they were 'right here in Britannia': the town is Britain, Britannia is the kingdom and Sosaria is the world. Until this file the townsfolk persona said '... in {town}, in Britannia ...' and nothing else, and the model used the kingdom's name for the town. Re-read when it changes. enabled false = the persona text exactly as it was before (byte for byte).
_kingdom_towns: The towns of the kingdom, as decided for this shard (2026-11-15): Delucia and Papua (the Lost Lands) ARE in the kingdom; Luna and Umbra (Malas) and Zento (the Tokuno Islands) are NOT: a townsperson there is told its town's name and that 'here' means that town, and nothing about a kingdom or a world.
_not_a_town: Region names the shard can send that are not a town. No place line at all for these.
